model.name: RbDetailDrawer.closeAndMinimize
model.description: R27.8 (full-lifecycle, corrected): the drawer state machine per Tron — X->MINIMIZE (not close), open-minimized peek, grab-bar toggles peek<->expand, close->reopens-on-select, HARD INVARIANT every select opens (any prior state). closeAndMinimize orchestrates the grab-bar toggle; paired with X->minimize + unconditional select->open + visible [minimized] peek.
